## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 378 captures during February 2024. Activity was completed through the scheduled clinic sessions, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below. No further activity categories are included in this report.

## Image quality

There were 17 ungradable images. The ungradable rate was 4.5. This measure identifies captures that could not be used for grading and supports routine review of image acquisition and clinic processes. The result should be considered alongside the total capture activity for the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 87 referable results from the submitted captures. The median lag from image capture to grading was 2. This indicates the typical interval recorded for cases that entered the grading process. Results are reported for the month as a whole and should be interpreted with the image-quality information above, including the 17 ungradable images. Together, these measures provide a concise operational view of activity, image usability, and grading performance at West Gate Eye Clinic during February 2024.
